subject: Bridge agent handoff: impact assessment and evidence pull
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finvault.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@finvault.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming relay/bridge agent handoff (Aug 17) — scope + ask

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads-up: our infra team will be performing a relay agent handoff for the FinVault -> Redwood telemetry bridge on Aug 17. The change reassigns a temporary transit agent (RelayProxy-7) to a new cloud region for a 72-hour pilot.

We expect no customer-visible downtime, but security/compliance require an evidentiary snapshot (dataflow diagram, short-lived access logs, and list of subprocessors touched during the pilot). Can Redwood provide: 
- explicit list of subprocessors that will touch FinVault data during the pilot window, including region/jurisdiction for each 
- a short dataflow diagram (redwood tenant -> relay -> storage) annotated for transit/jurisdiction
- an access-log snapshot for the first 24 hours after handoff (UTC timestamped)

We need this packet by EOD Aug 15 to satisfy our internal audit and legal review. Attaching our minimal evidence template for reference.

Thanks,
Marta
Head of Platform Security
FinVault Inc.
[attachment: finvault-evidence-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finvault.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming relay/bridge agent handoff (Aug 17) — scope + ask

Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up and the template. We can support this, and we'll aim to get the packet to you by EOD Aug 15.

Internal plan: Kim, Ben — can you own gathering the subprocessor list + quick dataflow diagram? Jordan, please standby for access-log extraction once the handoff completes (we only need the first 24 hours as requested).

A few clarifications from our side:
- The temporary transit agent is operated by our telemetry partner, StreamRelay (subprocessor). StreamRelay will perform ephemeral processing in us-west-2 for the pilot.
- On paper the only external subprocessor that will see unredacted FinVault data during transit is StreamRelay; storage backends are within Redwood-managed S3 buckets (encrypted at rest) in us-east-1.
- We will include the KMS jurisdiction and whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed.

If you have any IP allowlist entries or special retention carve-outs, flag them now.

-Vanessa
Director, Partnerships 
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming relay/bridge agent handoff (Aug 17) — scope + ask

Vanessa / team — taking this. Quick note on items and owner: 
1) Subprocessor inventory & jurisdictions — Ben (I will help draft a short statement).
2) Dataflow diagram — I will produce a single-slide diagram and annotate transit/jurisdiction.
3) Access-log snapshot — Jordan, please confirm log retention window and the simplest export (CSV).

Ben: StreamRelay (streamrelay.co) is the transit processor. They host ephemeral relay instances in us-west-2; per contract they do not persist full payloads beyond ephemeral buffering. We will request their processing statement and include the excerpt in the packet.

Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Senior Security Programs Manager
[attachment: streamrelay-processing-stmt.pdf (application/pdf)]

—Kim
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finvault.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming relay/bridge agent handoff (Aug 17) — scope + ask

Hi all — attaching the requested artifacts for the pre-handoff packet. Items included: 
- dataflow-diagram.pdf (annotated: relay in us-west-2, keystore in us-east-1)
- access-log-snapshot.csv (sample of previous pilot window; will provide the live export within 24 hours of Aug 17 handoff completing)

Attachment stubs: [dataflow-diagram.pdf (application/pdf)], [access-log-snapshot.csv (text/csv)], [streamrelay-processing-stmt.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
